data.body: Landed as Gerrit change 2475 (commit e831291dd94c, merged to main). All 4 ACs verified: ADR 0109 exists/indexed (gen_adr_index.py --check and check_adr_numbers.py both pass) and cites ADR 0054 + epic 6982; docs/plan-review-gate.md's new section has the tier-selection table + per-tier noise-band rule + ADR link; passing-code-review.md has the pointer section; cost table cross-checked against ledger.jsonl (tier1 $0.112/run, tier2-full $6.96-11.83, tier2-single-criterion E2 $0.093/run, tier2-diagnostic $0.27).
